source.issue_title: Allow safety invariants and proofs to depend on lifetimes

required_relation.invariant: For a non-zero-sized referent, the backing allocation lives for at least 'a.
required_relation.reason: The input reference supplies the allocation-liveness guarantee for the same lifetime carried by the result.

counterexample_shape.consequence: A safe Ptr can be constructed whose claimed lifetime outlives the allocation, and a later safe as_ref can materialize a dangling reference.

retained_v1_collision.reference_lifetimes: not represented in SafeType::Reference and mapped to the referent type
retained_v1_collision.result: The V1-generated IsValid/type surface has no source lifetime parameter on which the PtrInner allocation-liveness invariant can depend.
